final:

| File | Creator | Created | Priya Nair comment on Jun 10? |
|------|---------|---------|-------------------------------|
| Vendor Agreement Renewal.pdf | Dana Whitfield ✅ | **May 20** ❌ | Yes ✅ |
| Facilities Report.pdf | Dana Whitfield ✅ | **Mar 15** ❌ | No (Sam Rivera) ❌ |
| Marketing Plan.pdf | **Leo Park** ❌ | **Jun 3** ✅ | No (Omar Haddad) ❌ |

Each condition matches a *different* file, but none satisfies all of them:
- Dana Whitfield's files were created **May 20** and **Mar 15** — not June 3.
- The only June 3 file (Marketing Plan.pdf) was created by **Leo Park**, and its Jun 10 comment was from **Omar Haddad**, not Priya Nair.
- The only file with a **Priya Nair comment on June 10** (Vendor Agreement Renewal.pdf) was created on **May 20**, not June 3.

**No file matches, so I did not add the tag.** Let me know if you meant one of the near-matches (e.g., the June 3 Marketing Plan, or the Priya-commented Vendor Agreement Renewal) and I'll tag that one instead.
